highlights: Ideal for connecting high-performance audio components, like CD players, Blu-Ray players, DAT recorders, DVD players, game consoles and other audio devices with a digital optical interface (S/PDIF) to a receiver/preamplifier, audio processor or digital-to-analog converter
The fiber-optic cable prevents electromagnetic and radio frequency noise that an electrical cable may incur, offering clearer audio for a more genuine rendering of the originally recorded sound.

With Aluminum case the durable nylon braid that protect cable from protects the cable from kinks, cuts, scratches and nicks. Pecision-polished and corrosion-resistant gold plated optical connector provide maximum conductivity and minimize signal loss.
Compatible with S/PDIF, ADAT's, Dolby Digital & DTS; With removable rubber tips to protect cable when it's not in use.
Simply connect each end to its respective port on a compatible device, then you can enjoy your favorite music, movies, video games with more pure and clearer sound.
